violated_contract: An existing released route must continue accepting its published opaque path IDs and integer shapes; new arbitrary character or numeric bounds cannot silently narrow v1 while the checked-in OpenAPI snapshot remains stale.
canonical_prevention: Preserve the released path shapes and owner-scoped domain lookups. Validate actual storage address validity before I/O, rather than assuming historical IDs match a new UUID-like charset. Generate snapshots and run compatibility checks together; pin both valid opaque legacy IDs and malformed-address rejection in route tests. New intentionally narrower contracts require versioned endpoints.
